description:
🔗 Download the skills: https://aiengineer.co/start

Most agentic coding content focuses on harness tips, setup tweaks, and model choice. None of that helps much if the design is wrong. Design and planning are the two parts of the process that are still on you, because agents already handle most of the build, verification, and deployment work.

Skills used in the video: https://aiengineer.co/start/
